51592565.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to N-terminal his6-tagged human recombinant RORgamma LBD (261 to 518 residues) expressed in Sf9 insect cells assessed as dissociation constant by SPR analysis

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods - Surface Plasmon: The SPR binding assays were conducted using a Reichert 4 SPR instrument. The RORγ-LBD protein was immobilized on a CMS chip through covalent coupling with the SPR assay buffer (PBST (1×), 0.05% (v/v) surfactant Tween-20, and 0.25% (v/v) dimethyl sulfoxide, pH 6) according to standard procedure. The probe 12h was 2-fold diluted with assay buffer and then injected at a flow of 10 μL/min for 90 s to contact, followed by dissociation for 240 s, respectively. The equilibrium dissociation constant of the probe 12h was determined by TraceDrawer evaluation software.
original_paragraph.Figure 5 caption: Figure 5. (A) Binding curves of probe 12h to RORγ-LBD determined by surface plasmon resonance. (B) Fluorescence polarization values of different concentrations of probe 12h in the Tris-HCl buffer. (C) Saturation binding curve of probe 12h to RORγ-LBD using FP.
original_paragraph.Figure 5A data: The SPR binding curve (Figure 5A) shows signal (in RU) over time (s). The x-axis ranges from 0 to 250 s. The y-axis ranges from 0 to 50 RU. The curve is labeled with K_D=280.2 nM. The legend indicates concentrations: 0.02 μM, 0.04 μM, 0.08 μM, 0.16 μM, 0.31 μM, 0.63 μM, 1.25 μM, 2.5 μM.
original_paragraph.Results and Discussion - Development of: Following the identification of the optimal probe 12h, we proceeded to evaluate its binding affinity with RORγ-LBD through surface plasmon resonance (SPR), yielding a K_D value of 280.2 ± 54.3 nM (Figure 5A).

assay_conditions.running_buffer_composition: PBST (1×), 0.05% (v/v) surfactant Tween-20, and 0.25% (v/v) dimethyl sulfoxide
